name: adapt_reactive_config_csharp_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time Greeter.cs's own text contains 'Hello' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt) instead of a fixed prompt count, then Config.Name changes under it
prompts: This project (app.csproj already set up as an executable) has a Config.cs with a public const string Name. Create Greeter.cs with a public static class Greeter containing a public static method Greet() that returns "Hello, " + Config.Name + "!", reading Config.Name (do not copy or hardcode its value).
Config.Name may have changed since you last checked it. Make sure Greeter.Greet() still returns a string built from the CURRENT value of Config.Name, not a stale or hardcoded one.

disruptions.description: Config.Name changed World -> Universe, triggered reactively once Greeter.cs's first draft appeared (not a fixed step count)
